TemplateHome.Title: MAP Module API Catalog
TemplateHome.Description: Interactive smoke-test labs for supported MAP module APIs.

TemplateNavigation.Title: Navigation lab
TemplateNavigation.StepCNote: Opened without pushing B. Back returns directly to navigation A.

TemplateHeaderUi.Title: Header and UI lab
TemplateHeaderUi.UiStateNote: Live host state is separate from persisted AppConfig. Original values are restored when leaving.
TemplateHeaderUi.HostGapNote: Host gap: the current host stores HeaderKind but does not render different visuals.

TemplateDatabase.Title: Database lab
TemplateDatabase.OfflineNote: No database request runs during initialization. Offline endpoint errors are rendered safely.
TemplateDatabase.RecommendedNote: Configured DbName is read-only because BasePage helpers always use the menu configuration.
TemplateDatabase.SyntheticNote: Synthetic contract examples document response shapes; they are not server responses.

TemplateConfig.Title: Configuration and platform lab
TemplateConfig.EditNote: The draft is cloned even when no configuration exists. Save is manual and never restarts the application.
TemplateConfig.RestartNote: Restart is separate from Save. Desktop starts a new process; Web reloads.
TemplateConfig.RestartConfirmTwo: This ends the current session. Continue?

TemplateLifecycle.Title: Lifecycle lab
TemplateLifecycle.CancellationNote: Navigate away while the loop runs. BasePage cancels the page token and isolates cleanup failures.
